defs.def: a formal choice that you make in an election or at a meeting in order to choose sb or decide sth 选票；票
an occasion when a group of people vote on sth 投票；选举；表决

ex.s: Each day, 27 kids  41  “The Thinking Laboratory.” That was the   42   students voted for after deciding that “Room 104” was too   43   .
ex.t: 每天，27个孩子都____"思维实验室"。那是学生们投票选出的名字，因为他们觉得"104室"太____了。

ex.s: In 1973, I was teaching elementary school.Each day, 27 kids  41    “The Thinking Laboratory.”That was the      42     students voted for after deciding that “Room 104” was too   43   .
ex.t: 1973年，我在教小学。每天，27个孩子____41____“思维实验室”。那是学生们在认定“104室”太____43____之后投票选出的____42____名字。

ex.s: Vote in class for the best interview.
ex.t: 在班里投票选出最佳访谈。

ex.s: Vote in class for the most 3 effective and creative survival guide.
ex.t: 在班里投票选出第3项最实用、最具创意的求生指南。

defs.def: the total number of votes in an election 投票总数；选票总数
the vote given by a particular group of people, or for a particular party, etc. （某一群体的）投票总数；（某一政党等的）得票总数
the right to vote, especially in political elections （尤指政治选举中的）投票权，选举权，表决权

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: However, there may still be age-based restrictions for certain rights and responsibilities, such as the right to vote.
ex.t: 然而，某些权利和责任可能仍有基于年龄的限制，比如投票权。

defs.def: to show formally by marking a paper or raising your hand which person you want to win an election, or which plan or idea you support 投票（赞成/反对）；表决（支持/不支持）；选举

ex.s: His teacher ,Thomas Whaley ,is next to him, whispering support.“…Vote for …me …”Except for some stumbles, Chris is doing amazingly well.
ex.t: 他的老师托马斯·惠利在他旁边，轻声鼓励他。"'投……给……我……'"除了一些磕绊，克里斯的表现非常出色。

defs.def: to choose sb/sth for a position or an award by voting 选出，推举（某人担任某职）；表决（授奖给某人）
to say that sth is good or bad 表明，认为，公认（某事好或坏）
to agree to give sb/yourself sth by voting 投票同意
to suggest sth or support a suggestion that sb has made 提议；建议；支持（建议）
